retainedReference.title: Cattle Car Memorial to the Deportees, Yad Vashem

pictures.author: Grauesel
pictures.observations: Actually viewed: red-brown wooden side, horizontal planking, sliding door, upper vents, two-axle underframe and tapered open steel truss/gussets below the truncated track.

pictures.author: Gary Todd
pictures.observations: Actually viewed: land-end brake cabin with three small windows and pitched cap, steps/handrails on both sides, buffers/central coupler, rails/sleepers and long elevated track toward the wagon. Camera GPS is not the model location.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Cattle Car Memorial to the Deportees, Yad Vashem: independent red-brown two-axle wooden wagon on the mapped truncated railway, with shallow barrel roof, closed sliding doors, recessed upper side vents, metal ribs/chassis, buffers/coupler and the distinctive raised end brake cabin with three inset windows, side access steps and handrails. A tapered steel cantilever truss, cross bracing, ties and rails continue toward the higher land end. No copied lettering, car interior, visitors, forest, plaques or independent campus structures.
